title: Minish Cap 3DS
author: tinaut1986
description: Fork of zelda-tmc-3ds: dual-screen Minish Cap port aimed at 60 fps on Old and New 3DS, installs as its own app
preinstall_message: Requires a legally obtained The Minish Cap GBA ROM (USA or EUR) in sdmc:/3ds/Minish Cap 3DS/ and a dumped DSP firmware for sound.
